import json
from mcp import C
c=C('confluence-gym')
cursor=None; out=[]
while True:
    a={'limit':250}
    if cursor: a['cursor']=cursor
    r=json.loads(c.call('get_pages',a))
    for p in r.get('results',[]):
        out.append((p['id'],p.get('spaceId'),p.get('title')))

    if not nxt: break
    import urllib.parse as u

    if not cursor: break
for o in out: print(*o,sep='\t')
EOF
